summary: No readable source found for a fire lookout called Lloyd in Ontario; the provincial tower dataset page the record cites did not render.
notes_for_editor: No story written: no source could be cited for any fact about a lookout here. The GeoHub dataset page renders only its title, 'Tower', both in the cached fetch and in a WebFetch of its /about page. Two Canadian searches and four firelookout.ca slug guesses (lloyd, lloyd-tower, lloyd-lookout, lloyd-fire-lookout) found no Lloyd lookout record. The record's coordinates (48.378218, -83.304228) are unverified. Its kind 'tower' may come from a general provincial tower dataset rather than a fire lookout list; that is a hypothesis, not an established error, and no correction is proposed. Needs a human to find a fire-lookout source for these coordinates, or to drop the record.
